description: AppsForBharat | 2–5 years of frontend engineering experience About the role At AppsForBharat, we’re looking for a Frontend Engineer to work on the frontend app of our core consumer products and build fast, accessible experiences for millions of devotees worldwide. You’ll work closely with Product and Design to improve how users discover, navigate, and transact on the web. With a large community of devotees using Sri Mandir every day, even small improvements can make a meaningful difference at scale.
